releaseNotes:
• Liquid Glass Three-Dock Morphing Island: Bottom dock fluidly collapses on scroll into a compact Apple Music 3-dock layout (Explore launcher, Center mini player with artwork/title/controls, and Search)
• Apple Music Contextual Dropdown & Action Sheet: Liquid glass modal bottom sheet with 25px blur, #1C1C1E background, song header, 4 circular quick-share shortcuts, and 6 clean action rows with single dividers
• Featured Artists Bottom Sheet: 60px circular artist avatars, listeners metrics, Apple Music Follow button, and profile viewer
• Pure typography consistency across app using GoogleFonts.inter
• Rebuilt search pipeline with multi-tier ranking, transliteration matching, and zero missing titles
• Real-time Room Together synchronized collaborative listening
• High-performance SQLite + JSON store with optimized caching
